 has a weak password hash:

 , so a leaked hash is cheap to crack - re-hash the password with a higher work factor
------------------------------------

  bob

 has a weak password hash: 

  10000 iterations is below the 600000 recommended for pbkdf2-sha256

 , so a leaked hash is cheap to crack - re-hash the password with a higher work factor
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - control plane Basic authentication user 

  carol

 has a weak password hash: 

  m=64,t=1 is below the m=19456,t=2 recommended for argon2

 , so a leaked hash is cheap to crack - re-hash the password with a higher work factor
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - controlPlaneBasicAuthenticationAllowInsecure is true, so control plane Basic passwords are accepted without TLS where anyone on the network path can read them - use this only in tests
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - Forward proxy is configured to trust ALL X.509 certificates (mockserver.forwardProxyTLSX509CertificatesTrustManagerType=ANY). Certificate validation is disabled — this should be used only in development; prefer JVM or CUSTOM in production.
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - MockServer is signing TLS traffic with the bundled default Certificate Authority, whose private key is published in the MockServer jar — anyone can forge certificates it trusts, so this must not be relied on as real interception security. To use a unique private CA set mockserver.dynamicallyCreateCertificateAuthorityCertificate=true (or run with --proxy-setup).
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - Forward proxy is configured to trust ALL X.509 certificates (mockserver.forwardProxyTLSX509CertificatesTrustManagerType=ANY). Certificate validation is disabled — this should be used only in development; prefer JVM or CUSTOM in production.
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - forwardProxyBlockPrivateNetworks is not set, so forward and proxy actions can reach loopback, private-network and cloud-metadata addresses; a future major release will change its default to true, which blocks them. Set mockserver.forwardProxyBlockPrivateNetworks (or MOCKSERVER_FORWARD_PROXY_BLOCK_PRIVATE_NETWORKS) to true to adopt the new default now, or to false to keep reaching those addresses; either value removes this warning
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - localBoundIP is not set, so MockServer listens on every network interface and can be reached from other machines; a future major release will change its default to 127.0.0.1, which only this machine can reach. Set mockserver.localBoundIP (or MOCKSERVER_LOCAL_BOUND_IP) to 127.0.0.1 to adopt the new default now, or to 0.0.0.0 to keep listening on every interface, as a container or a shared test environment needs; either value removes this warning
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - attemptToProxyIfNoMatchingExpectation is not set, so a request that matches no expectation is forwarded to the host it names, which makes MockServer an open proxy for anyone who can reach it; a future major release will change its default to false, which returns 404 instead. Set mockserver.attemptToProxyIfNoMatchingExpectation (or MOCKSERVER_ATTEMPT_TO_PROXY_IF_NO_MATCHING_EXPECTATION) to false to adopt the new default now, or to true to keep proxying unmatched requests; either value removes this warning
------------------------------------
<timestamp> - the HTTP parsing limits mockserver.maxInitialLineLength (65536 bytes now, 8192 later), mockserver.maxHeaderSize (262144 bytes now, 16384 later), mockserver.maxChunkSize (2147483647 bytes now, 16384 later) are not set, and a future major release will lower their defaults to the values shown; a request whose first line or headers exceed the new limits will then be refused with 414 or 431. Set each property to its new value to adopt it now, or to its current value to keep it; a property that is set is left out of this warning
------------------------------------

{"id":1,"jsonrpc":"2.0","result":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{"tools":{"listChanged":false},"resources":{"subscribe":false,"listChanged":false},"prompts":{"listChanged":false},"sampling":{}},"serverInfo":{"name":"MockServer","version":"9.2.0"},"instructions":"MockServer is an HTTP(S) mock server and proxy for testing. Use these tools to mock APIs, debug failing requests, and verify implementations:
- Mock APIs: 'create_expectation', 'create_expectation_from_openapi', and 'create_expectations_from_recorded_traffic' (turn traffic already recorded via the proxy into mocks).
- Debug a request that did not match: call 'explain_unmatched_requests' after a failed test run to see, for each request that hit the server, the closest expectations ranked by similarity with field-level diffs and a remediation hint — no need to reconstruct the request. 'debug_request_mismatch' does the same for a request you supply. 'explain_request' takes one received request's correlation id (from 'retrieve_logs') and says which expectation serves it now and why each one ahead of it lost; 'diagnose_config' shows which settings are in effect and where they came from. 'suggest_expectation_fix' proposes a guarded JSON patch for each close expectation; 'lint_expectations' finds expectations that can never match; 'explain_forward_failure' says why a forward or proxied request got a 502; 'test_template' dry-runs a response or forward template.
- Verify an implementation: 'verify_request' / 'verify_request_sequence' check requests were made; 'verify_traffic_against_openapi' checks recorded traffic conforms to an OpenAPI contract; 'run_contract_test' sends spec-derived example requests to a running service and checks the responses; 'run_resiliency_test' sends malformed and boundary-case requests and reports which inputs the service failed to handle gracefully.
- Deterministic LLM testing: 'record_llm_fixtures' snapshots LLM/MCP traffic recorded through the proxy into a committable, secret-free fixture file; 'load_expectations_from_file' replays it.
Readable resources expose live state: mockserver://expectations, mockserver://requests, mockserver://logs, mockserver://unmatched, mockserver://configuration."}}
